[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Privacy and failure behavior"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- Recall results and storage receipts become model-visible, persistent Harness
messages. They may be"},{"id":"p30s2","text":" sent to the configured model provider. Local encryption
does not make injected context private from"},{"id":"p30s3","text":" that provider.
- Common credential patterns are rejected before recall or explicit storage.
This he"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"uristic is not a complete secret scanner. Remove secrets from input;
retain only safe purpose/locati"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"on references in memory.
- Logs contain operation/error categories, not prompts, memory bodies, raw "},{"id":"p30s6","text":"CLI
errors, or credentials. No plugin-owned files are written to the library.
- Engine failure produ"},{"id":"p30s7","text":"ces a bounded notice and lets the primary task continue.
Windows arguments travel as JSON stdin to a"},{"id":"p30s8","text":" constant PowerShell script;
POSIX arguments are passed directly. Neither embeds user text in shell "},{"id":"p30s9","text":"source.
- Processes run in the agent's verified working directory through the Harness
subprocess pro"},{"id":"p30s10","text":"vider. Its execution environment determines where `rsrs` and
the memory runtime must be installed (i"},{"id":"p30s11","text":"ncluding remote profiles)."}],"truncated":true}
